trust_decision.summary: A reference name is trusted to be a path relative to .git and becomes a filesystem path in the unexported dotgit layer with no containment check; the decision point is DotGit.SetRef/RemoveRef/Ref, not ReferenceName.Validate.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary speaks of reference-name validity, and this is the only reference-name check in the tree (documented as git-check-ref-format at plumbing/reference.go:143-174); it is the first place an engineer greps to and where the git rules already live.

fix_sites.entry_point: storer.ReferenceStorer.SetReference / CheckAndSetReference (storage/filesystem/reference.go:15,20); reached by Remote.Fetch, Repository.Clone, transport.ReceivePack server write path, Remote.Push tracking-ref update
storer.ReferenceStorer.Reference (storage/filesystem/reference.go:25); also the old-value read inside checkAndUpdateReferenceStorerIfNeeded (repository.go:1381)
storer.ReferenceStorer.RemoveReference (storage/filesystem/reference.go:40); reached by transport.ReceivePack delete commands (plumbing/transport/receive_pack.go:347) and prune
shared write wrapper chosen by billy.CapabilityCheck
non-RDWR filesystem branch (Create, documented at dotgit_setref.go:56-62)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: setRefNorwfs exists only for simple filesystems that cannot open RDWR and are documented as single-process (dotgit_setref.go:56-62), so a solver can argue that branch is the caller's trusted filesystem and needs no containment, leaving the write outside refs/ open there.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: HEAD must remain writable as a single-component name (worktree.go:291, worktree.go:307), and the empty-clone placeholder target refs/heads/.invalid must round-trip (repository.go:412 writes it, repository.go:1146 compares it); a containment check that requires a refs/-prefixed name, or that reuses ReferenceName.Validate (which rejects dot-prefixed components at plumbing/reference.go:205), breaks init/clone and every HEAD update.

O6_input_shapes: multi-component relative names whose components are . or .. (dotgit.go:1373 splits on / then joins, so the name is cleaned into a path)
absolute single-component names (no refs/ requirement anywhere in the storage layer)
symbolic-reference targets parsed out of a ref file via NewReferenceFromStrings (plumbing/reference.go:247-252, dotgit.go:1003-1014) and later written back as a ref name
remote-advertised names spliced through a wildcard refspec into the local dst (config/refspec.go:119-135)

O7_producer.where: plumbing/protocol/packp/advrefs_decode.go:127-129 (v0/v1 ref list) and plumbing/protocol/packp/lsrefs.go:228 (v2 ls-refs output)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Reflog write/read/delete for a reference: logs/ + raw name joined with no validation, reached through storer.ReflogStorer AppendReflog/Reflog/DeleteReflog
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the library's own writes only use HEAD and short names, and ReflogStorer is a low-level API called by trusted caller code
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, different file from the ref-writing sites

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PackRefs deletes loose ref files whose names come from unvalidated packed-refs lines
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: packed-refs is on-disk repository state, so a caller able to write it already controls the repository

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Reflog delete via DeleteReflog joins logs/ + raw name and calls fs.Remove
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: reflog deletion is a maintenance API for names the caller already owns

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a ref-name containment helper mirroring the existing Module() clean-and-prefix check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the tree already ships exactly this defence for submodule names with ErrModuleNameEscape and tests at dotgit_test.go:47-70, so a maintainer fixing ref names would naturally copy the pattern

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the same containment call on the reflog paths (logs/)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: reflog names are the same ReferenceName type written under a sibling directory; a maintainer hardening ref storage would plausibly extend the guard to logs/

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a shared wrapper that rejects a name before delegating to any of the three dotgit entry points
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ReferenceStorage is the only exported surface over dotgit for refs, so a maintainer could put the check at the wrapper instead of in dotgit

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal (reference-name containment in the .git layout)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25.0 (go.mod:4); go build ./... and go test ./...; no cgo or external services needed for the storage/plumbing packages
O10_build.project_tests: storage/filesystem/dotgit/dotgit_test.go (SuiteDotGit, incl. Module containment tests at :47-70), storage/filesystem reference and reflog suites, plumbing/reference_test.go Validate table (:128-170), storage/tests/storage_test.go, remote_test.go with go-git-fixtures

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: tighten or newly call ReferenceName.Validate at the ReferenceStorage boundary, which never sees fetch/receive-pack names and breaks HEAD and refs/heads/.invalid

out_of_scope_notes: Only this advisory's ref-name containment was examined; the neighbouring modules/ submodule containment at storage/filesystem/dotgit/dotgit.go:1489-1496 is a separate, already-applied protection and was used only as a design precedent.
